subtext: One durable feature record supports planning and delivery.
title: Plan and deliver the same feature
statement: As a Product Manager, I can describe a planned feature and later mark it built without recreating its knowledge, so the team retains the original intent through delivery.
overview: Delivery status is explicit product intent. A planned feature can hold the same Essay, stories, criteria, prototype associations and design context as a built feature. Story acceptance and code coverage are independent of built/planned placement.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Features lists built capabilities and Roadmap lists planned capabilities; neither view includes features in the other delivery category.
Changing a feature from planned to built preserves its canonical identity and URL, stories, Essay, associated design and prototypes, labels and milestone.
A planned feature opens the same reading pages for its authored Essay, stories, acceptance criteria and associated design context as a built feature.
Roadmap orders lower positive priority numbers before higher numbers, keeps unranked work after ranked work, and preserves creation order for ties.
